lib/llms-markdown.ts.name: Component markdown rewrite
lib/llms-markdown.ts.description: Records, for every site component, the markdown the mirror prints instead: Var values, Callouts as blockquotes, Cards as link lists.

lib/mdx-comments.ts.name: Comment stripping
lib/mdx-comments.ts.description: Removes comment-only MDX expressions from the compiled tree and from the markdown mirrors.

lib/mdx-options.ts.name: Shared MDX options
lib/mdx-options.ts.description: Lists the remark plugins the site and check-links both compile with, so anchor validation sees the transforms the reader gets.

lib/preview-text.ts.name: Preview plain text
lib/preview-text.ts.description: Hands remarkStructure plain text for each paragraph and heading, with Var values expanded, so link previews carry no tags or markers.

lib/var-links.ts.name: Var placeholders in links
lib/var-links.ts.description: Expands {var:name} in link, image and definition URLs and JSX URL attributes from content/vars.json; an unknown name passes through.
